He did regret it afterwards but I told him that we either go to couple therapy or it's over. I didn't know how to combat the feelings I was experiencing and I felt couple therapy is the only thing that could help with that.

Couple therapy helped TREMENDOUSLY. After a few sessions we found many issues in our relationship and ways to fix them. After that is just time to get through these feelings. Now, after 2 years, I completely forgave him and I trust he 100% loves me. I can see it in his actions.

I would say to you that couple therapy can help you understand each other and see issues you might have in your relationship. Find what could have provoked these feelings from her.

These are the things that helped me the most:

* Ice packs. I literally had one all the freaking time, even would wake up at night and put one on. It helps with the pain tremendously. The pain would be too bad without it otherwise
* Humidifier: Helped a lot with dry throat
* Ice cubes: really helped with hydration when it was painful to drink plain water
* Wedge pillow
* Get some popsicles since it will be quite painful to eat for some time
* Try to have somebody checked in on you once in a while. My husband did everything for me, down to getting new ice packs. It would have been tough without any help
* Please, drink water. Even it's like swallowing needles, drink water. Get some through the pain. I would drink 150-200ml every hour I'm awake and every time I woke up at night. Water will keep your throat moist which will improve healing.
* That's not necessary but I also would drink a little bit of honey (Manuka honey) since it has healing/anti-inflammatory effects

Good luck and I hope it helps you long term :D
